intent: An enrichment already paid for is never bought again because its embedding failed.
observable_outcome: get-context catalog lists the amended rule as reviewed, proven by its test.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A search document is listable only once its enrichment is finished or it has an embedding a vector search can find. An enrichment whose embedding call failed is still stored as enriched, without a vector, so it is listable at once; the enrichment backfill later embeds that stored text without calling the enrichment model again, and stores the vector only if the document has not been rewritten since it was claimed.
